analysis: The trial completed successfully but reduced authoritative macro validation HR@10 to 0.5488, versus the supplied 0.5675 reference and historical best 0.5800. Category HR@10 was 0.6000 Movies_and_TV, 0.6050 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.4650 Electronics, and 0.5250 CDs_and_Vinyl. Separating intact-context final-target training from corrupted-history auxiliary training did not improve this configuration. Possible causes include reduced final-target loss weight and changed gradient interactions between views; the result does not isolate either cause. Allocated GPU time was 448.15 seconds. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent masked Transformer per category with tied item embeddings, jointly learned item bias, signed relative attention biases, and gated recent-item fusion. Each sampled prefix produces a clean view masking only the final target and a corrupted view additionally masking historical items. The shared network minimizes equally weighted clean final-target and corrupted auxiliary cross-entropies, excluding the final position from auxiliary supervision and falling back to final-target loss when auxiliary masks are absent. Both losses share 1024 sampled negatives with target collisions masked. Seeds, optimizer, hyperparameters, validation checkpoint selection, dataset routing, and trial-local artifacts are preserved. Prediction strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category and uses one forward pass on intact history plus a final query mask.
